title: Reduced tensor with an algebraic closure detects separability of a finite field extension
statement: Let k be a field, let K/k be a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension], and let kbar be an algebraic closure of k [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. If K tensor_k kbar is reduced (has no nonzero nilpotent elements), then K/k is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension].
